```{r employment growth v fed contract growth}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Step 1: Summarize CBP for 2018 and 2022
cbp_growth <- cbp %>%
  filter(year %in% c(2018, 2022)) %>%
  select(county_fips, year, total_emp) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = total_emp, names_prefix = "emp_")

# Step 2: Summarize contract obligations for same years
contract_growth <- fedcon %>%
  filter(fiscal_year %in% c(2018, 2022)) %>%
  group_by(county_fips, fiscal_year) %>%
  summarise(total_obligation = sum(total_obligation, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fiscal_year, values_from = total_obligation, names_prefix = "contract_")

# Step 3: Combine and calculate change
county_growth <- cbp_growth %>%
  inner_join(contract_growth, by = "county_fips") %>%
  mutate(
    emp_change = emp_2022 - emp_2018,
    contract_change = contract_2022 - contract_2018
  )


ggplot(county_growth, aes(x = contract_change / 1e6, y = emp_change)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Change in Federal Contracts vs. Employment (2018–2022)",
    x = "Change in Federal Obligations (Millions USD)",
    y = "Change in Employment",
    caption = "Source: CBP and USAspending"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```


```{r share of fed contracts by naics}
sector_summary <- fedcon %>%
  filter(fiscal_year >= 2018) %>%
  group_by(naics_group) %>%
  summarise(total_obligation = sum(total_obligation, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_obligation / sum(total_obligation) * 100)

ggplot(sector_summary, aes(x = reorder(naics_group, share), y = share)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkgreen") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Federal Contract Distribution by Industry (2018–2022)",
    x = "NAICS Industry Group",
    y = "Share of Total Obligations (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
